repairs.before: That year, Emperor Cheng sent attendants Xu Meng, Lüqiu Xing, and others bearing credentials to appoint Huang General Who Guards the Army, governor of Ping Province, Great Shanyu, Duke of Liaodong; bearer of credentials, overall commander, investiture by mandate on the model of Hui’s precedent.
repairs.after: That year, Emperor Cheng sent the yezhe Xu Meng, Lüqiu Xing, and others bearing credentials to appoint Huang General Who Guards the Army, governor of Ping Province, Great Shanyu, and Duke of Liaodong; with credentials, overall command, and authority to make appointments under imperial mandate, just as in Hui’s precedent.
repairs.sourceQuote: 是歲，成帝遣謁者徐孟、閭丘幸等持節拜皝鎮軍大將軍、平州刺史、大單于、遼東公，持節、都督、承制封拜，一如廆故事。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: That year Emperor Cheng invested him as general who guards the army, governor of Pingzhou, great shanyu, and duke of Liaodong, with full authority to enfeoff subordinates as Hui had held.
repairs.reason: 謁者 is rendered as the office yezhe, restoring 遣謁者徐孟、閭丘幸等持節 and the three grants 持節、都督、承制封拜 with 一如廆故事; all offices and names preserved.

repairs.before: That year Emperor Cheng invested him as general who guards the army, governor of Pingzhou, great shanyu, and duke of Liaodong, with full authority to enfeoff subordinates as Hui had held.
repairs.after: That year Emperor Cheng sent the envoys Xu Meng, Lüqiu Xing, and others with credentials to invest Huang as General Who Guards the Army, governor of Ping Province, great shanyu, and duke of Liaodong, with credentials, overall command, and authority to enfeoff by mandate, as Hui had held.
repairs.sourceQuote: 是歲，成帝遣謁者徐孟、閭丘幸等持節拜皝鎮軍大將軍、平州刺史、大單于、遼東公，持節、都督、承制封拜，一如廆故事。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: That year, Emperor Cheng sent attendants Xu Meng, Lüqiu Xing, and others bearing credentials to appoint Huang General Who Guards the Army, governor of Ping Province, Great Shanyu, Duke of Liaodong; bearer of credentials, overall commander, investiture by mandate on the model of Hui’s precedent.
repairs.reason: Restores 遣謁者徐孟、閭丘幸等持節 and lists 持節、都督、承制封拜 separately; offices 鎮軍將軍、平州刺史、大單于、遼東公 all kept, consistent with literal.

repairs.before: Thereupon executed Ren’s placed guardians and magistrates, divided and moved great clans of Liaodong to Jicheng, established the three counties of Heyang, Wuci, and Xile, and returned.
repairs.after: Thereupon he executed the guardians and magistrates Ren had installed, moved the great clans of Liaodong in groups to Jicheng, established the three counties of Heyang, Wuci, and Xile, and returned.
repairs.sourceQuote: 於是斬仁所置守宰，分徙遼東大姓於棘城，置和陽、武次、西樂三縣而歸。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: He executed Ren’s officials, relocated the leading Liaodong families to Jicheng, set up three new counties, and marched home.
repairs.reason: Adds the subject for 斬 and renders 仁所置守宰 and 分徙遼東大姓於棘城 accurately; the three counties 和陽、武次、西樂 retained.

repairs.before: He executed Ren’s officials, relocated the leading Liaodong families to Jicheng, set up three new counties, and marched home.
repairs.after: He executed Ren’s officials, relocated the leading Liaodong families to Jicheng, established the three counties of Heyang, Wuci, and Xile, and marched home.
repairs.sourceQuote: 於是斬仁所置守宰，分徙遼東大姓於棘城，置和陽、武次、西樂三縣而歸。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: Thereupon executed Ren’s placed guardians and magistrates, divided and moved great clans of Liaodong to Jicheng, established the three counties of Heyang, Wuci, and Xile, and returned.
repairs.reason: Restores the omitted county names 和陽、武次、西樂 from 置和陽、武次、西樂三縣而歸, matching the literal field.

repairs.before: He named Feng Yi chancellor, Han Shou marshal, and distributed ministerial and command posts among Pei Kai, Yang Wu, and the rest.
repairs.after: He named Feng Yi state chancellor and Han Shou marshal, and appointed Pei Kai, Yang Wu, Wang Yu, Li Hong, Du Qun, Song Gai, Liu Zhan, Shi Cong, Huangfu Zhen, Yang Xie, Song Huang, Ping Xi, Zhang Hong and others as ministers and generals.
repairs.sourceQuote: 以封弈為國相，韓壽為司馬，裴開、陽騖、王寓、李洪、杜群、宋該、劉瞻、石琮、皇甫真、陽協、宋晃、平熙、張泓等並為列卿將帥。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: Made Feng Yi state chancellor, Han Shou marshal, Pei Kai, Yang Wu, Wang Yu, Li Hong, Du Qun, Song Gai, Liu Zhan, Shi Cong, Huangfu Zhen, Yang Xie, Song Huang, Ping Xi, Zhang Hong and others concurrently ministers and generals.
repairs.reason: Restores all thirteen names in 裴開…張泓等並為列卿將帥 and 國相 as state chancellor, matching the literal list exactly.

repairs.before: Jilong sent his general Ma Qiu leading host to welcome Liao; Ke ambushed seven thousand picked cavalry at Miyun Mountain, greatly defeated them, captured their marshal Yang Yu, general Xianyu Liang, and led Duan Liao and his division host back.
repairs.after: Jilong sent his general Ma Qiu leading a host to meet Liao; Ke stationed seven thousand picked cavalry in ambush at Miyun Mountain and greatly defeated them, captured their marshal Yang Yu and general Xianyu Liang, and brought Duan Liao and his followers back.
repairs.sourceQuote: 季龍遣其將麻秋率眾迎遼，恪伏精騎七千於密雲山，大敗之，獲其司馬陽裕、將軍鮮于亮，擁段遼及其部眾以歸。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: Shi Hu sent Ma Qiu to fetch him; Murong Ke ambushed seven thousand elite riders at Miyun, captured Yang Yu and Xianyu Liang, and brought Duan Liao in.
repairs.reason: 恪伏精騎七千於密雲山 means Ke placed his own cavalry in ambush; keeps 大敗之, 司馬陽裕, 將軍鮮于亮 and 及其部眾.

repairs.before: Shi Hu sent Ma Qiu to fetch him; Murong Ke ambushed seven thousand elite riders at Miyun, captured Yang Yu and Xianyu Liang, and brought Duan Liao in.
repairs.after: Shi Hu sent his general Ma Qiu with troops to meet Duan Liao. Murong Ke stationed seven thousand elite cavalry in ambush at Miyun Mountain and routed them, captured marshal Yang Yu and general Xianyu Liang, and brought Duan Liao and his followers back.
repairs.sourceQuote: 季龍遣其將麻秋率眾迎遼，恪伏精騎七千於密雲山，大敗之，獲其司馬陽裕、將軍鮮于亮，擁段遼及其部眾以歸。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: Jilong sent his general Ma Qiu leading host to welcome Liao; Ke ambushed seven thousand picked cavalry at Miyun Mountain, greatly defeated them, captured their marshal Yang Yu, general Xianyu Liang, and led Duan Liao and his division host back.
repairs.reason: Restores 率眾, 大敗之, the roles 司馬/將軍, and 及其部眾, and correctly attributes the ambush 伏精騎七千 to Murong Ke.

repairs.before: Although Huang styled King of Yan, there was yet no court command; thereupon sent his chief clerk Liu Xiang to present victory at the capital, concurrently stating the intent of provisional authority, and requesting a great campaign to pacify the Central Plain.
repairs.after: Although Huang styled himself King of Yan, there was yet no court mandate; he thereupon sent his chief clerk Liu Xiang to report his victory at the capital, also explaining his provisional assumption of authority and requesting a great campaign to pacify the Central Plain.
repairs.sourceQuote: 皝雖稱燕王，未有朝命，乃遣其長史劉祥獻捷京師，兼言權假之意，並請大舉討平中原。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: Though he called himself king of Yan, the court had not recognized it, so he sent Liu Xiang to report victories, explain his provisional rule, and ask for a northern expedition.
repairs.reason: Keeps 長史, 獻捷京師, 兼言權假之意 and 大舉討平中原; adds the needed reflexive for 稱燕王 without adding content.

repairs.before: Though he called himself king of Yan, the court had not recognized it, so he sent Liu Xiang to report victories, explain his provisional rule, and ask for a northern expedition.
repairs.after: Though he called himself King of Yan, he still lacked a court mandate, so he sent his chief clerk Liu Xiang to report his victory at the capital, explain his provisional assumption of authority, and ask for a major campaign to pacify the Central Plain.
repairs.sourceQuote: 皝雖稱燕王，未有朝命，乃遣其長史劉祥獻捷京師，兼言權假之意，並請大舉討平中原。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: Although Huang styled King of Yan, there was yet no court command; thereupon sent his chief clerk Liu Xiang to present victory at the capital, concurrently stating the intent of provisional authority, and requesting a great campaign to pacify the Central Plain.
repairs.reason: Restores 長史, 京師 and 討平中原 (not merely a northern expedition); 未有朝命 as lacking a court mandate is accurate.

repairs.before: Ke rode victory to pursue them, beheaded and captured over thirty thousand grades, built a fort at Fancheng and returned.
repairs.after: Ke, riding the victory, pursued them, beheaded and captured over thirty thousand heads, built a garrison at Fancheng and returned.
repairs.sourceQuote: 恪乘勝追之，斬獲三萬餘級，築戍凡城而還。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: Murong Ke pursued, killed or captured thirty thousand, and fortified Fancheng on the withdrawal.
repairs.reason: 斬獲三萬餘級 kept as over thirty thousand, 乘勝 and 築戍凡城而還 rendered accurately as a garrison then return.

repairs.before: Murong Ke pursued, killed or captured thirty thousand, and fortified Fancheng on the withdrawal.
repairs.after: Murong Ke pressed the victory in pursuit, killed or captured over thirty thousand, built a garrison at Fancheng, and returned.
repairs.sourceQuote: 恪乘勝追之，斬獲三萬餘級，築戍凡城而還。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: Ke rode victory to pursue them, beheaded and captured over thirty thousand grades, built a fort at Fancheng and returned.
repairs.reason: Restores 乘勝 and 餘 in 三萬餘級, and 築戍凡城而還 as building a garrison and returning rather than fortifying on withdrawal.

repairs.before: Yu Bing, terrified yet unable to coerce him from afar, joined He Chong in recommending that the court recognize the title of king of Yan.
repairs.after: On seeing the memorial and the letter, Yu Bing was greatly alarmed; because Huang was so far away and beyond his power to control, he joined He Chong and others in memorializing that Huang be allowed to style himself King of Yan.
repairs.sourceQuote: 冰見表及書甚懼，以其絕遠，非所能制，遂與何充等奏聽皝稱燕王。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: Bing seeing the memorial and letter was greatly afraid; because they were extremely distant, not what they could control; thereupon with He Chong and others memorialized to permit Huang to style King of Yan.
repairs.reason: Restores 見表及書 and 等 in 與何充等奏聽皝稱燕王; 以其絕遠，非所能制 rendered faithfully.

repairs.before: Thereupon led cavalry twenty thousand out Wengong Pass, long drove reaching Ji city, advanced crossed Wusui Ford, entered Gaoyang; wherever passed burned granaries, plundered and moved You and Ji over thirty thousand households.
repairs.after: Thereupon he led twenty thousand cavalry out through Yeweng Pass, drove straight to Ji city, advanced across Wusui Ford, and entered Gaoyang; wherever he passed he burned the stores, and he plundered and relocated more than thirty thousand households from You and Ji.
repairs.sourceQuote: 於是率騎二萬出蠮螉塞，長驅至於薊城，進渡武遂津，入于高陽，所過焚燒積聚，掠徙幽、冀三萬餘戶。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: He led twenty thousand horse through Wengong Pass, raced to Ji, crossed Wusui Ford into Gaoyang, burned depots, and carried off thirty thousand households from You and Ji.
repairs.reason: 蠮螉 read ye1 wēng per cited character databases, so Yeweng Pass; keeps 長驅, 武遂津, 焚燒積聚 and 三萬餘戶.

repairs.before: He led twenty thousand horse through Wengong Pass, raced to Ji, crossed Wusui Ford into Gaoyang, burned depots, and carried off thirty thousand households from You and Ji.
repairs.after: He then led twenty thousand cavalry out through Yeweng Pass, drove straight to Ji city, advanced across Wusui Ford into Gaoyang, burning the stores wherever he passed, and carried off more than thirty thousand households from You and Ji.
repairs.sourceQuote: 於是率騎二萬出蠮螉塞，長驅至於薊城，進渡武遂津，入于高陽，所過焚燒積聚，掠徙幽、冀三萬餘戶。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: Thereupon led cavalry twenty thousand out Wengong Pass, long drove reaching Ji city, advanced crossed Wusui Ford, entered Gaoyang; wherever passed burned granaries, plundered and moved You and Ji over thirty thousand households.
repairs.reason: Uses Yeweng for 蠮螉塞 consistent with paired literal, restores 餘 in 三萬餘戶 and 薊城; worker 'Yiweng' in the reason is not adopted in the text.

repairs.before: Murong Han shattered his army and took nearly every man alive.
repairs.after: He sent Murong Han with cavalry to strike them; Moqian Hun was badly defeated and escaped alone, while his entire host was taken captive.
repairs.sourceQuote: 遣翰率騎擊之，渾大敗，僅以身免，盡俘其眾。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: Sent Han leading cavalry to strike them; Hun was greatly defeated, barely himself escaped, wholly captured their host.
repairs.reason: Restores 遣翰率騎擊之 and 僅以身免; 盡俘其眾 as entire host captured; Moqian Hun matches s0100 idiomatic.

repairs.before: When Duan Liao asked Shi Hu for an escort, Yang Yu served as chief clerk under Ma Qiu.
repairs.after: When Duan Liao asked Shi Hu to send troops to receive him, Yang Yu, while serving as Left Assistant, concurrently served as marshal to Ma Qiu, General Who Campaigns in the East.
repairs.sourceQuote: 段遼之請迎于季龍也，裕以左丞領征東麻秋司馬。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: At the time of Duan Liao’s request to welcome from Jilong, Yu as left assistant concurrently led Eastern Campaign Ma Qiu’s major.
repairs.reason: 司馬 is marshal not chief clerk; restores 以左丞領 and the title 征東 for Ma Qiu, consistent with s0071 司馬 = marshal.

repairs.before: At the time of Duan Liao’s request to welcome from Jilong, Yu as left assistant concurrently led Eastern Campaign Ma Qiu’s major.
repairs.after: When Duan Liao requested that Jilong receive him, Yu, as Left Assistant, concurrently served as marshal to Ma Qiu, General Who Campaigns in the East.
repairs.sourceQuote: 段遼之請迎于季龍也，裕以左丞領征東麻秋司馬。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: When Duan Liao asked Shi Hu for an escort, Yang Yu served as chief clerk under Ma Qiu.
repairs.reason: 段遼之請迎于季龍 means Duan Liao asked Jilong to receive him; 以左丞領征東麻秋司馬 is a concurrent marshal post under the General Who Campaigns in the East.

repairs.before: Even a county post can bless one’s heirs—let alone chancellor.
repairs.after: Shaoyou said that a post as commandery clerk was enough to shelter one's descendants; how much more the post of chancellor of a state!
repairs.sourceQuote: 少遊有雲，郡掾足以廕後，況國相乎！
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: Shao You said, a commandery aide suffices to shade posterity—how much more a state chancellor!
repairs.reason: Restores the speaker 少遊 and renders 郡掾 as commandery clerk and 國相 as state chancellor; 廕後 as sheltering descendants is accurate.

repairs.before: The Empress Dowager has died in indignation.
repairs.after: And now the Empress Dowager, overcome with indignation, has suddenly passed away.
repairs.sourceQuote: 至今太后發憤，一旦升遐。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: Until now the Empress Dowager gave vent to her indignation and in one morning ascended to distant heaven.
repairs.reason: Proposed idiomatic restores 至今 as present-point transition, 發憤 as indignation, and 一旦 suddenness for 升遐; matches the Chinese against the incomplete before.

repairs.before: The former king, by divine martial sage strategy, preserved one region; by might he destroyed traitors and by virtue he won the distant; therefore people of the nine provinces and foreign tribes beyond the frontier came carrying infants for ten thousand li, like infants returning to a loving father; the displaced exceeded the old population more than tenfold, the people were many and the land narrow, so those without fields were fourteen in ten.
repairs.after: The former king, by divine martial sage strategy, preserved one region; by might he destroyed traitors and by virtue he won the distant; therefore people of the nine provinces and foreign tribes beyond the frontier came carrying infants for ten thousand li, like infants returning to a loving father; the displaced exceeded the old population more than tenfold, the people were many and the land narrow, so those without fields were four in ten.
repairs.sourceQuote: 先王以神武聖略，保全一方，威以殄奸，德以懷遠，故九州之人，塞表殊類，繈負萬里，若赤子之歸慈父，流人之多舊土十倍有餘，人殷地狹，故無田者十有四焉。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: Murong Hui, by divine martial strategy, preserved this region, destroyed traitors by might and won the distant by virtue; people of the nine provinces and foreign tribes came carrying infants for ten thousand li like children to a loving father. Refugees outnumbered the old population more than tenfold; land was scarce and fourteen in ten had no fields.
repairs.reason: 無田者十有四焉 in 人殷地狹 means four in ten, not fourteen in ten; the proposed literal correctly repairs the quantity while preserving all other propositions.

repairs.before: Murong Hui, by divine martial strategy, preserved this region, destroyed traitors by might and won the distant by virtue; people of the nine provinces and foreign tribes came carrying infants for ten thousand li like children to a loving father. Refugees outnumbered the old population more than tenfold; land was scarce and fourteen in ten had no fields.
repairs.after: Murong Hui, by divine martial strategy, preserved this region, destroyed traitors by might and won the distant by virtue; people of the nine provinces and foreign tribes came carrying infants for ten thousand li like children to a loving father. Refugees outnumbered the old population more than tenfold; land was scarce and four in ten had no fields.
repairs.sourceQuote: 先王以神武聖略，保全一方，威以殄奸，德以懷遠，故九州之人，塞表殊類，繈負萬里，若赤子之歸慈父，流人之多舊土十倍有餘，人殷地狹，故無田者十有四焉。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: The former king, by divine martial sage strategy, preserved one region; by might he destroyed traitors and by virtue he won the distant; therefore people of the nine provinces and foreign tribes beyond the frontier came carrying infants for ten thousand li, like infants returning to a loving father; the displaced exceeded the old population more than tenfold, the people were many and the land narrow, so those without fields were fourteen in ten.
repairs.reason: Same 十有四 quantity fix as the literal pair; idiomatic now reads four in ten and keeps 先王 deeds, 繈負萬里, and refugee scale intact.

repairs.before: Moreover flood and drought are misfortunes Yao and Tang did not escape; a king ought to dredge and maintain canals and ditches, follow the irrigation methods of Zheng Bai, Ximen, and Shi Qi; in drought open ditches as rain, in flood send water into channels; above no worry like the "Cloudy Han," below no trouble of mire and flood.
repairs.after: Moreover flood and drought are misfortunes Yao and Tang did not escape; a king ought to dredge and maintain canals and ditches, following the Zheng and Bai canals and the irrigation methods of Ximen and Shi Qi; in drought open ditches as rain, in flood send water into channels; above no worry like the "Yunhan," below no trouble of mire and flood.
repairs.sourceQuote: 且水旱之厄，堯、湯所不免，王者宜浚治溝澮，循鄭白、西門、史起溉灌之法，旱則決溝為雨，水則入於溝瀆，上無《雲漢》之憂，下無昏墊之患。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: Flood and drought, which Yao and Tang did not escape, require dredged canals and irrigation like Zheng Bai, Ximen, and Shi Qi; drought is eased by channels and flood by drainage, ending worry above and mire below.
repairs.reason: 鄭白 are the Zheng and Bai canals, not a person parallel to 西門 and 史起; restoring canal names and 《雲漢》 as Yunhan matches the Chinese.

repairs.before: Flood and drought, which Yao and Tang did not escape, require dredged canals and irrigation like Zheng Bai, Ximen, and Shi Qi; drought is eased by channels and flood by drainage, ending worry above and mire below.
repairs.after: Flood and drought, which Yao and Tang did not escape, require dredged canals and irrigation after the Zheng and Bai canals and the methods of Ximen and Shi Qi; drought is eased by opening channels to supply water like rain, and floodwaters are directed into drainage channels, so that above there is no anxiety like that expressed in Yunhan and below there is no misery from inundation.
repairs.sourceQuote: 且水旱之厄，堯、湯所不免，王者宜浚治溝澮，循鄭白、西門、史起溉灌之法，旱則決溝為雨，水則入於溝瀆，上無《雲漢》之憂，下無昏墊之患。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: Moreover flood and drought are misfortunes Yao and Tang did not escape; a king ought to dredge and maintain canals and ditches, follow the irrigation methods of Zheng Bai, Ximen, and Shi Qi; in drought open ditches as rain, in flood send water into channels; above no worry like the "Cloudy Han," below no trouble of mire and flood.
repairs.reason: Idiomatic likewise separates Zheng and Bai canals from Ximen and Shi Qi, and restores 決溝為雨, 入於溝瀆, and Yunhan anxiety versus 昏墊.

repairs.before: Huang issued an edict: “Feng Yu’s words frighten me.
repairs.after: Huang then issued an order, saying: “On reading the remonstrance of Recorder Feng, I am truly afraid.
repairs.sourceQuote: 皝乃令曰：「覽封記室之諫，孤實懼焉。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: Huang thereupon ordered, saying: “Having read Secretary Feng’s remonstrance, I truly fear it.
repairs.reason: Restores 乃令曰, 覽, and title 封記室 omitted in the before; Recorder Feng for 封記室 fits the remonstrance scene.

repairs.before: The heartland is still at war, so I cannot yet cut official posts.
repairs.after: The heartland is not yet pacified, warfare does not cease, and many have rendered meritorious and loyal service, so the official establishment cannot be reduced.
repairs.sourceQuote: 中州未平，兵難不息，勳誠既多，官僚不可以減也。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: The central plain is not yet pacified; military difficulty does not cease; merit and loyalty are already many—bureaucracy cannot be reduced.
repairs.reason: Covers 中州未平, 兵難不息, 勳誠既多, and 官僚不可以減也 without softening the ban on cutting posts.

repairs.before: Ministers who speak truth deserve patience—ignore wild rumors but heed good counsel.
repairs.after: For a minister to offer words that touch his ruler is most difficult; wild and baseless matters should all be brushed aside without inquiry, while one chooses what is good and follows it.
repairs.sourceQuote: 夫人臣關言於人主，至難也，妖妄不經之事皆應蕩然不問，擇其善者而從之。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: As for minister’s presenting words to the lord sovereign—most difficult; demonic and wild not-classic matters all ought to be swept away unasked; choose the good of them and follow them.
repairs.reason: Restores 關言於人主至難也 and the full 妖妄不經…擇其善者而從之 counsel structure against the compressed before.

repairs.before: Restore censured advisers to their posts.
repairs.after: They may all be restored to their original offices and still serve in the remonstrance bureau.
repairs.sourceQuote: 可悉復本官，仍居諫司。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: Can all restore original offices, still dwell in remonstrance offices.
repairs.reason: Restores 悉, 本官, and 仍居諫司 that the before collapsed into a bare restore.

repairs.before: Award him fifty thousand cash and invite anyone, high or low, to criticize me freely.”
repairs.after: So award him fifty thousand cash, and clearly announce inside and outside that whoever wishes to state my faults, whether noble or base, need have no taboo.”
repairs.sourceQuote: '其賜錢五萬，明宣內外，有欲陳孤過者，不拘貴賤，勿有所諱。」
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: Grant cash fifty thousand; clearly proclaim inside and outside: whoever wishes to state my faults, not constrained noble or base, do not have what is taboo.”
repairs.reason: Restores 明宣內外 and 有欲陳孤過者，不拘貴賤，勿有所諱 beside the fifty thousand cash award.

repairs.before: Elated, he returned, proclaimed an amnesty, renamed the palace Helong, and built a Buddhist monastery on the height.
repairs.after: Huang was greatly pleased, returned to the palace, pardoned those within his borders, named the new palace Helong, and built the Longxiang Buddhist monastery on the mountain.
repairs.sourceQuote: 皝大悅，還宮，赦其境內，號新宮曰和龍，立龍翔佛寺於山上。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: Huang greatly pleased, returned palace, pardoned those within his borders, styled the new palace Helong, established Dragon-Soar Buddha temple on the mountain.
repairs.reason: Restores 皝大悅, 赦其境內, 號新宮曰和龍, and the named 龍翔佛寺 omitted as a generic monastery.

repairs.before: Huang greatly pleased, returned palace, pardoned those within his borders, styled the new palace Helong, established Dragon-Soar Buddha temple on the mountain.
repairs.after: Huang was greatly pleased, returned to the palace, pardoned those within his borders, named the new palace Helong, and established the Longxiang Buddhist temple on the mountain.
repairs.sourceQuote: 皝大悅，還宮，赦其境內，號新宮曰和龍，立龍翔佛寺於山上。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: Elated, he returned, proclaimed an amnesty, renamed the palace Helong, and built a Buddhist monastery on the height.
repairs.reason: Aligns the temple name as Longxiang with 龍翔 and keeps 赦其境內 and 號新宮曰和龍 in the literal field.

repairs.before: He wrote a primer to replace the Rush to Literacy and fifteen moral essays for the royal sons.
repairs.after: He personally composed the Taishang Chapter to replace the Jijiu, and also wrote fifteen chapters of Canonical Admonitions to teach the sons of the nobility.
repairs.sourceQuote: 親造《太上章》以代《急就》，又著《典誡》十五篇，以教胄子。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: Personally composed the “Supreme Lord Chapter” to replace the “Rush to Literacy,” also wrote fifteen pieces of “Classic Admonitions,” to teach the sons of the house.
repairs.reason: Restores proper titles 《太上章》,《急就》, and 《典誡》十五篇 for teaching 胄子.

repairs.before: Personally composed the “Supreme Lord Chapter” to replace the “Rush to Literacy,” also wrote fifteen pieces of “Classic Admonitions,” to teach the sons of the house.
repairs.after: He personally composed the Taishang Chapter to replace the Jijiu, and also wrote fifteen chapters of Canonical Admonitions, to teach the sons of the nobility.
repairs.sourceQuote: 親造《太上章》以代《急就》，又著《典誡》十五篇，以教胄子。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: He wrote a primer to replace the Rush to Literacy and fifteen moral essays for the royal sons.
repairs.reason: Literal now matches those three titles and renders 胄子 as sons of the nobility rather than narrowing to the house alone.

repairs.before: Murong Ke seized Nansu from Goguryeo and left a garrison.
repairs.after: Murong Ke attacked Goguryeo’s Nansu, took it, posted a garrison, and returned.
repairs.sourceQuote: 慕容恪攻高句麗南蘇，克之，置戍而還。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: Murong Ke attacked Goguryeo’s Nansu, took it, set garrison and returned.
repairs.reason: Restores 攻, 克之, 置戍, and 而還 against the before that dropped the attack verb and return.

repairs.before: In his third regnal year he sent Murong Jun and Murong Ke with seventeen thousand horse against Puyu; they captured the king and fifty thousand subjects.
repairs.after: In the third year he sent his heir Jun and Ke with seventeen thousand cavalry to raid Puyu eastward; they took it, captured its king and more than fifty thousand of the tribe, and returned.
repairs.sourceQuote: 三年，遣其世子俊與恪率騎萬七千東襲夫餘，克之，虜其王及部眾五萬餘口以還。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: In the third year, sent his heir apparent Jun with Ke leading cavalry seventeen thousand east to raid Puyu, took it, captured their king and division host over fifty thousand mouths and returned.
repairs.reason: Bare 三年 is third year not regnal year; restores 世子俊, 東襲, 五萬餘, and 以還 with the cavalry count.

repairs.before: Yet the Hu still hold the Central Plain; I had hoped to cleanse them for Murong Hui’s sake.
repairs.after: But the rebel Hu barbarians straddle and hold the Divine Land, and the Central Plain is not yet pacified. I always steeled my heart and swore that I would swallow up the vile caitiffs, above to fulfil the late king's dying wish and below to discharge my duty to the realm between the mountains and the sea.
repairs.sourceQuote: 但逆胡跨據神州，中原未靖，翰常克心自誓，志吞醜虜，上成先王遺旨，下謝山海之責。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: But the rebellious Hu stride occupying the divine continent; the central plain is not yet quieted; Han constantly set heart to swear, intent to swallow the ugly bandits, above to complete the late king’s leftover command, below to apologize for the duty to mountains and seas.
repairs.reason: Restores 常克心自誓, 志吞醜虜, 上成先王遺旨, and 下謝山海之責 omitted in the short before.

repairs.before: But the rebellious Hu stride occupying the divine continent; the central plain is not yet quieted; Han constantly set heart to swear, intent to swallow the ugly bandits, above to complete the late king’s leftover command, below to apologize for the duty to mountains and seas.
repairs.after: But the rebellious Hu occupy the Divine Land, and the Central Plain is not yet pacified; Han has always steeled his heart and sworn an oath, intent on swallowing up the vile enemies, above to fulfil the late king's last instructions and below to discharge his duty to the land of mountains and seas.
repairs.sourceQuote: 但逆胡跨據神州，中原未靖，翰常克心自誓，志吞醜虜，上成先王遺旨，下謝山海之責。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: Yet the Hu still hold the Central Plain; I had hoped to cleanse them for Murong Hui’s sake.
repairs.reason: Fixes misleading apologize for 下謝山海之責 to discharge the duty, while keeping the oath, 醜虜 aim, and 先王遺旨.

repairs.before: As for minister’s presenting words to the lord sovereign—most difficult; demonic and wild not-classic matters all ought to be swept away unasked; choose the good of them and follow them.
repairs.after: For a minister to present words to his sovereign is most difficult; absurd and unfounded matters should all be set aside without inquiry, while one chooses what is good and follows it.
repairs.sourceQuote: 夫人臣關言於人主，至難也，妖妄不經之事皆應蕩然不問，擇其善者而從之。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: Ministers who speak truth deserve patience—ignore wild rumors but heed good counsel.
repairs.reason: 夫人臣關言於人主，至難也 is rendered fully; 妖妄不經之事皆應蕩然不問 as absurd unfounded matters set aside without inquiry; 擇其善者而從之 with neutral 'one' correctly keeps the sovereign as the chooser.

repairs.before: As the Odes says, “No good word goes unanswered.”
repairs.after: As the Odes says, “No word goes unanswered.”
repairs.sourceQuote: 《詩》不云乎：'無言不酬。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: The Odes does it not say: “No word without answer.”
repairs.reason: 無言不酬 contains no 善, so 'good word' is an addition; 'No word goes unanswered' matches the source and the paired literal 'No word without answer'.

repairs.before: The beasts intertwined, sported in the air, dropped their horns, and flew away.
repairs.after: The two dragons crossed their heads, sported and soared, shed their horns, and departed.
repairs.sourceQuote: 二龍交首嬉翔，解角而去。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: The two dragons crossed heads, sported and soared, shed horns and departed.
repairs.reason: 二龍交首嬉翔，解角而去 names two dragons and 交首; the replacement restores both, keeps 嬉翔 and 解角而去, and matches the paired literal.

repairs.before: Duan Juan, Xianbei chieftain and Jin general, sought him eagerly.
repairs.after: At that time the Xianbei shanyu Duan Juan, who held the Jin titles of General of Agile Cavalry and Duke of Liaoxi, had a refined fondness for men of talent and humbly invited Yang Yu.
repairs.sourceQuote: 時鮮卑單于段眷為晉驃騎大將軍、遼西公，雅好人物，虛心延裕。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: At the time Xianbei Shanyu Duan Juan was Jin’s General of Agile Cavalry and Duke of Liaoxi; by nature he loved men of talent and humbly invited Yu.
repairs.reason: Proposed idiomatic restores 時, romanizes 單于 as shanyu, and recovers 晉驃騎大將軍, 遼西公, 雅好人物, and 虛心延裕 against the compressed before.
